2.23.35
Tablix.TablixCorner
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Tablix.TablixCorner element specifies the TablixCorner of a Tablix. The Tablix.TablixCorner
element is optional and MUST NOT be specified more than once.
The Tablix.TablixCorner element MUST be specified if the tablix has both a TablixRowHierarchy
element child with a TablixHeader element descendant, and a TablixColumnHierarchy element child
with a TablixHeader element descendant. If this element is specified, it is of type TablixCorner.
Following is the parent element of the Tablix.TablixCorner element.
Parent elements
Tablix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Tablix.TablixCorner element.
 <xsd:element name="TablixCorner" type="TablixCornerType" minOccurs="0" />
